text:
infra-bot: ALERT: ap-southeast-2 gpu-pool failing boots: 22% KMSDecryptionFailure + STS AssumeRole denies. Impact: capacity shortfall for weekend runs.

lisa: noticed `kms:Decrypt` denies from `gpu-bootstrap-key` after the key policy change at 04:03 UTC. Also seeing trust policy tighten on `gpu-node-role` — now requires `aws:SourceVpc` match.
dan: stack traces show instances calling keystore via privatelink with `aws:SourceVpc` value set to the old VPC id (we migrated / renamed the VPC last week). ephemeral nodes are hitting deny.
wei: that's probably the rollout bug I warned about. The key policy PR replaced `Principal` allowlist with a conditional using `aws:SourceVpc`. We didn't add the new VPC id into the condition.
lisa: audit-bot: show me CloudTrail for the failed KMS:Decrypt calls in the last 20m.
audit-bot: returning 3 events: callerIdentity -> ec2 i-0abc..., sourceVpc: vpc-123old, endpointId: vpce-0444abcd, keyId: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-2:111:key/boot-0f1.
dan: and our logshipper shows no recent PutObject to s3://audit-shipper/apac/ because the egress rule to S3 was tightened in the same change window (04:00 UTC). logs missing -> slower forensics.
wei: two simultaneous changes: key-policy-v3 + egress-s3-tighten. Oof.
lisa: mitigation plan: 1) emergency add `vpc-123old` and `vpc-456new` to key-policy condition for kms:Decrypt, 2) relax `gpu-node-role` trust to accept either vpc id or allow ec2:CalledVia privatelink for 30m, 3) open egress to s3 audit bucket from privatelink subnets.
dan: doing step 1 now. CLI snippet: 
```
aws kms put-key-policy --key-id boot-0f1 --policy file://boot-allow-vpc.json --region ap-southeast-2
# boot-allow-vpc.json adds Condition StringEquals aws:SourceVpc: ["vpc-123old","vpc-456new"]
```
wei: while we change policies, we should avoid full rollback. target a 10% canary of the warm pool and validate boot traces.
lisa: agreed. dan, run canary and report KMS error rate over 5m. Also open a temporary presigned S3 PUT endpoint we can push buffered logs to if audit shipper still blocked.
dan: canary started at 2026-03-21T18:05:10Z. KMS decrypt fails dropped from 22% -> 2.1% in the canary slice within 90s.
infra-bot: note: warm-pool autoscaler increased desired by 30% due to retry storms; cost burn ~+$4.2k/day for apac if maintained.
wei: open egress to s3 for privatelink subnets applied. logs streaming back into s3 now. we got the full CT events for the failed boots.
lisa: forensics show the ip mapping of vpce changed during the VPC rename; condition relying on SourceVpc was brittle. We should switch to `aws:VpcEndpointId` or `aws:SourceVpcArn` in key policy.
dan: follow-up small safety: add an explicit KMS key policy exception for `arn:aws:iam::111:role/gpu-provisioner-role` allowing Decrypt when `aws:CalledVia` = `vpce`. puts a safety net for privatelink calls.
wei: created ticket INFRA-APAC-567 to: 1) replace SourceVpc conditional with VpcEndpointId, 2) add automated test to verify key-policy references during VPC rename, 3) add auditshipper egress smoke test in PR gating.
lisa: tagging finance with @sre-finance: expect ~4k/day surge during mitigation window, estimate 12h -> $2k.
finance-bot: acknowledged. emergency spend approved up to $3k for today. Please paste final cost request in #sre-finance.
dan: rolling canary -> 50% now. No new KMS denies in canary for 6m.
wei: after full rollout we'll rotate the key policy to be endpoint-based and add an automated monitor that alerts at >1% KMS decrypt denies over 5m.
lisa: final decision summary: 1) applied short-term KMS policy patch to allow old/new VPC ids, 2) relaxed trust for gpu-node-role for 30m during rollout, 3) reopened s3 egress for audit shipper, 4) canary -> 50% -> 100% with 5m observation windows, 5) follow-ups: endpoint-based condition and PR smoke-tests.
dan: rollout 100% done at 2026-03-21T18:29:59Z. capacity back to normal. closing incident.
wei: please add a short postmortem in #postmortems with timeline, root cause (policy used SourceVpc + VPC rename + egress tighten), and the cost impact.
lisa: will write the postmortem. pinning.
